scope: Complete predeclared 12-hour A/B failure record for historical method2 against identical-sky ab9/ad262144 references, with finite direct correction. All 576 sensor values and all failures retained; this is failed acceptance evidence.

declaration.reference_policy: Identical generated diffuse/ground patch sky plus actual continuous solar source. High-quality native full trace minus native centroid direct trace plus independent all-ray 4096-direction solid-angle quadrature. Reflected solar in this reference remains continuous centroid-sampled; direct finite shadows are separately checked analytically.
declaration.tolerance: max(5.0 lx, 5% of reference) at every sensor
declaration.shadow_fixture: Separate elevated-radiance eleven-point finite-disc fixture and native all-ray/culling equality regression; not replaced by these weather hours
